orig.il: and with all the valiant men
unto me, Thou shalt not build
and I will be his father

orig.gloss: and/ you will give [it] as inheritance
he will let himself be found

orig.il: of thee; but if thou forsake
him, he will cast thee off
thereof, and of the upper chambers
of all that he had by the spirit
with thee; he will not fail
with thee for all manner of workmanship
